description: Save a report definition with explicit projects and evidence consent. Before enabling, obtain explicit chat confirmation of workspace, selected projects, cadence/time, evidence mode, verified email recipients and recurring allowance/provider use. Solo includes monthly factual reports; Team weekly/monthly factual reports; Business daily/weekly/monthly Smart Reports with AI analysis and safe factual fallback. Only AI definitions may send redacted evidence to a configured model. Reuse the request UUID after a lost acknowledgement and read the saved definition back. Capacity does not multiply plan limits.
name: create_report_definition
